title: Security, Abuse, Moderation & Incident Operations
objective: Operationalize SMB-14 security/privacy/family hardening through authorization regression, secret/config handling, rate/abuse controls, block/report flows, moderation queues where applicable, dependency/security checks and incident runbooks.
acceptance: Declared security/abuse/privacy incident scenarios can be detected, contained, evidenced, recovered and reviewed without unauthorized data exposure.
boundaries: BRP-01..07 and SMB-01..16 remain sealed predecessor authority.

Tester distribution, public beta/community activation, release, paid providers, commerce and BRP-09+ remain unauthorized.
BRP must complete through BRP-11 BETA_READY before normal SMB-17 activation.
next_action: Await owner Continue to govern-start BRP-08 — Security, Abuse, Moderation & Incident Operations. Do not begin implementation before authority is granted.
